title: Phaladeepika
author: Mantreswara
_scan_note: Clean digital text layer, one book page per PDF page. Goes through producers/pdf_text.py, not OCR. Bounding boxes are therefore in PDF points (page is 595x842) rather than image pixels, so every geometry offset below is in points and is roughly a quarter of the equivalent Brihat Jataka value.
_verse_note: This edition contains NO Devanagari at all -- it is an English translation and commentary, with the source shlokas rendered only as numbered English paragraphs ('7. The Moolatrikona signs ...'). There is no danda anywhere in the book. The Devanagari verse-block machinery therefore never fires, which is correct: there is no Sanskrit here to set off. Verse numbering is preserved inline in the prose exactly as printed.
_chapter_note: A chapter opener is a bold, bare 'Chapter N' at the top of a page, with the chapter title on the following bold line or two. The trailing $ matters: the 'Chapter N: Title' form appears only in the table of contents on p0004-p0009, and matching it there would invent six spurious chapters.
_page_number_note: 264 of 265 pages print the page number as the LAST line on the page, not the first.
_figure_note: Geometry in PDF points: printed lines are ~24pt apart and the body column is ~470pt wide, so these are roughly a quarter of the 300dpi pixel defaults.
